The '''Mod V cyberarm''' or '''Cyberarm Mod V''' was a make of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Limb/Legends|arm]] made by [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]], the leading manufacturer in cybernetic body parts. The limb was designed to replace an arm lost in an accident, and was compatible with hundreds of different [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Mod V also provided greater strength than most organic arms, and as a result some individuals "upgraded" their natural, healthy, organic limbs with cybernetic replacements. The model was available for 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cyberarm Mod V was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2013]] and written by [[Sterling Hershey]].
